edges.reason: msg.sender balance is debited in ERC20.transfer
msg.sender allowance and balance are read/written in transferFrom
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender]
constructor assigns ruler = msg.sender, granting privileged role
setRuler authorization compares msg.sender and ruler, with a zero-address bypass
setMinter requires msg.sender == ruler
pull requires msg.sender == castle
manuallyAdjustDoge requires msg.sender == admin or auth[msg.sender]
ERC721.transfer requires msg.sender == ownerOf[tokenId]
ERC721.transferFrom validates msg.sender as owner or approved
safeTransferFrom inherits the transferFrom approval checks for msg.sender
onlyOwner restricts execution to msg.sender == admin
noCheaters uses msg.sender and requires msg.sender == tx.origin
withdraw is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
initialize grants auth[msg.sender] = true
setImplementer is restricted by onlyOwner
mint entry points pass msg.sender as the recipient to _mintDoge
_rand mixes block.timestamp into the randomness seed
random() mixes block.timestamp into the seed
mintCoolDownPassed compares block.timestamp with stored mint timestamp
_claim computes timeDiff and reward from block.timestamp
claimableTreat scales the reward with timeDiff derived from block.timestamp
_doAction persists uint88(block.timestamp) into activities
_rand includes tx.origin in the hashed seed
random() includes tx.origin in the hashed seed
noCheaters requires msg.sender == tx.origin, blocking contract callers
_delegate executes delegatecall with attacker-supplied calldata to a chosen target
fallback forwards execution to _delegate
fallback delegates to the hardcoded impl address when implementer[msg.sig] is unset
implementer[msg.sig] selects the delegatecall target in the fallback
setImplementer writes selectors into the implementer mapping used by the fallback
pull transfers tokens out and only then calls pullCallback on msg.sender
the castle contract called from pull can reenter pull before completion
safeTransferFrom performs an external staticcall to the receiver
arbitrary receiver contract is invoked with onERC721Received data (staticcall)
unchecked balanceOf[to] += value can overflow silently
unchecked balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom
unchecked balanceOf[to]++ in ERC721._mint
unchecked totalSupply -= value can underflow
the ruler == address(0) branch lets any caller change the ruler
withdraw pushes the contract balance to msg.sender via transfer
noCheaters uses extcodesize assembly to fingerprint callers

amount is validated against whitelist[msg.sender] in presaleMintWithEth

id keys rerollCountHistory and the doge being rerolled

rerollType indexes rerollPrice and rerollCountHistory in rerollWithTreat
to is the mint recipient in _mintDoge
to is the receiver contract called in safeTransferFrom
value is added to balanceOf[to] inside an unchecked block
value is subtracted/added to balances in transferFrom
spender is the allowance key written by approve
tokenId determines the owner checked in ERC721.transfer
tokenId is validated for approval in ERC721.transferFrom
tokenId is forwarded to the receiver in safeTransferFrom

ids array drives the batch loop in doActionWithManyDoges

size from extcodesize gates the noCheaters modifier

normalization_plan.reason: the amount argument only bounds the whitelisted mint loop and has no independent semantic role
the id argument is only used to index activities and ownership inside the internal action handler
rerollType only selects the price and trait index during reroll
the recipient argument is only consumed when minting a new token
value is only a balance delta applied inside the transfer routine
spender is only the allowance key written by approve
tokenId only identifies the token being validated and moved
seed is only hashed into the pseudorandom output
the ids array only drives the batch claim iteration
timeDiff is a temporary timestamp difference used to size the reward
rand_ is a temporary randomness value consumed by _randomize in reward math
cost is a transient price value burned from the caller
size is the transient extcodesize result used only by the anti-bot modifier
from is only the source address whose ownership/approval is validated
